presentation.label: IMPROVED MODULATION
presentation.summary: Hold FIX, CHRO or LFO and turn a knob to link it to velocity, aftertouch or the LFO; hold SCENE or PERF and turn to lock it in a scene or performance; record performance moves and scene changes.
presentation.overview: Hold FIX and turn any knob on a sound page: that parameter is linked to velocity, and the turn sets how much. Hold CHRO and turn to link it to aftertouch instead. While FIX, CHRO or LFO is held, every linked knob shows its amount the way stock shows a performance or scene lock. It fills stock's own four velocity and four aftertouch slots of the selected sound, so the links save with the kit, show in SOUND SETTINGS as usual and keep playing on a unit without the mod. Hold SCENE and turn a knob: the parameter is locked in the active scene, as scene edit does with the scene's pad held, without leaving the page. QPER + a pad links a performance or unlinks it; any number can be linked. Hold PERF and turn a knob: it edits that parameter's offset in every linked performance, and the knob inverts and shows it as it does for a held performance pad. PERF + PLAY clears them and PLAY again undoes that. PERF + RECORD and STOP copy and paste. PERF + YES writes what you hear into the kit and removes those locks; SCENE + YES does the same for a scene. FIX or CHRO + PLAY sets all the sound's velocity or aftertouch links to 0, and LFO + PLAY, RECORD or STOP clears, copies or pastes the LFO page from any page. In LIVE RECORDING the pads, the QPER knob, MIDI performance moves and scene changes are kept in a take that loops with the pattern; RECORD + YES writes it into the pattern as locks, RECORD + NO clears it. Scene changes follow LIVE RECORDING's quantize switch. (QPER Live Rec, a module of its own up to 0.3.0, is part of it since 0.5.0.)
highlights: Velocity, aftertouch or the LFO to any parameter in one gesture
Stays on the page you are playing
Uses stock's slots, saved with the kit
SCENE + knob writes a scene lock from the page
Sets a lock in every linked performance with one turn
FIX, CHRO, LFO, SCENE and PERF + PLAY clear, each with an undo or stock's own
PERF + YES moves them into the kit (SCENE + YES a scene)
Records pad, QPER knob and scene moves in LIVE RECORDING and plays them back, 8 points a step
usage: Select a sound track and press FLTR. Hold FIX and turn FRQ to the right: its box counts up and FRQ itself does not move. Play soft and hard hits: harder ones open the filter.
Press AMP, hold CHRO and turn DEC: pad pressure now lengthens the decay. Hold FIX and press a knob to set its link back to 0, or PLAY for all of them (PLAY again undoes).
Press FLTR, hold LFO and turn FRQ: the LFO now moves the filter. Keep turning to set the depth.
Hold SCENE: the active scene's locks show as boxes. Turn SWT: it becomes a lock in that scene, and the page stays. Still holding SCENE, press REC to copy the scene.
Hold QPER and press pad 1 to link its performance (more pads link more; a linked one unlinks). Then hold PERF, turn FLTR's cutoff up and let go.
Sweep the QPER knob: the cutoff comes in. When a position sounds right, hold PERF and press YES to keep it in the kit.
Press PERF, hold RECORD and press PLAY. While the pattern plays, press and squeeze pads 1 and 2, or engage a scene. Let go and listen to the next pass.
Hold RECORD and press YES to write the moves into the pattern.

access.location: The FIX, CHRO, LFO, SCENE, PERF and QPER keys, on a track's pages (FIX and CHRO on the sound tracks only) and in PERF, SCNE, MUTE and CHRO.
steps: Select a sound track and open its SYNTH, SAMPLE, FILTER, AMP or LFO page.
Hold FIX: linked knobs show their velocity amounts. Turn a knob to link it or change its amount.
Hold CHRO for aftertouch: the aftertouch amounts.
Hold SCENE and turn a knob: that parameter is locked in the active scene (or the last engaged one). Hold SCENE without a knob and let go: scene edit opens, as before.
Turn back to 0 to free the slot. Tap FIX alone to toggle fixed velocity, tap SAMPLER alone to open the recorder, as before.
Hold QPER and press a pad to link that one performance.
Hold PERF and turn a knob to set its offset.
PERF + PLAY clears the linked performance; press PLAY again to undo. PERF + RECORD copies it, PERF + STOP pastes.
PERF + YES moves them into the kit; SCENE + YES does the same for a scene.
In PERF mode, hold RECORD and press PLAY, then play the pads: the moves loop. RECORD + YES writes them into the pattern; RECORD + NO empties them, NO again undoes.

limitations: Each sound has four velocity and four aftertouch mods; with all four in use a popup says VELOCITY MODS FULL or AFTERTOUCH MODS FULL.
A FIX tap toggles fixed velocity on the release instead of the press.
While FIX or CHRO is held, the TRIG page's knobs, knobs turned with a trig held and FUNC + a knob do nothing.
FUNC + FIX, the FX track and a performance, scene or trig lock edit keep stock's behaviour.
SCENE held and let go with no knob opens scene edit on the release, not while it is held.
SCENE + knob with no scene engaged locks the scene engaged last (scene 1 until one has been since power-on), without engaging it. With all 48 scene locks in use it says SCENE LOCKS FULL.
While SCENE is held after a knob, every knob turn writes a scene lock, in LIVE RECORDING too, and the TRIG page's knobs do nothing.
The first knob event of a SCENE hold ends SCENE's hold as stock does when scene edit opens: any other key held at that moment loses its clean release.
During a FIX, CHRO or LFO hold SCENE does nothing, and during a SCENE hold FIX, CHRO and LFO do nothing.
With several performances linked, PERF + knob, PLAY, STOP and YES act on all of them (RECORD copies the lowest); to edit one alone, unlink the others or use performance edit.
FIX + PLAY and CHRO + PLAY set the amounts to 0 and keep the destinations, as a knob's press does. With FIX, CHRO or LFO held the transport keys the module takes do not start, stop or record.
LFO + RECORD, STOP and PLAY use stock's page routines; a second press pasted or cleared again in rytm-emu and on the author's unit, where stock's manual promises an undo.
Recorded scene changes follow LIVE RECORDING's quantize switch, which a new project has on: the nearest step. Performance moves are never quantized.
The gestures work on the sound pages and in PERF, SCNE, MUTE and CHRO, not in menus.
Until the QPER knob moves after power on, PERF + YES uses the amounts stock holds.

With SCENE or PERF held, PLAY, RECORD, STOP and YES act at once and the transport does nothing: SCENE or PERF rolled into PLAY clears the scene or performance (PLAY again undoes). QPER + PLAY is stock's again.
Recorded performance moves live in RAM until RECORD + YES writes them: a pattern change, project load or power off drops them.
The move lane holds 64 steps; a track at its own speed gets no locks from it.

load.display: About 0.5 % of the audio block idle (QPER's quick perf rec, measured on a unit); the rest is UI only
load.conditions: QPER's part, measured on an Analog Rytm MKII as QPER Live Rec, the audio handler timed on DTIM0: 0.2.0 in the author's 16-module set, stopped: 8.7 us a block before its idle early return, 5.1 us after; 0.2.2 alone against 0.2.1 on the same unit and kit: 3.6 us a block stopped (0.53 %) and 6.8 us playing (1.03 %). With moves to record, a pad held or a take playing back it runs in full each block. The rest of the module runs only on key events, knob turns and UI ticks, never in the audio path (read from the code). The fold changed none of QPER's code.

hardware.summary: On the author's Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74, 25 Nov 2026: a private development image of this version's source (R707, image CRC 8b6c1d98), RAM-booted over the flashed OS, scratch project, track 9 selected. The test rig, with the author's go and after two code reviews, ran 13 cases: FIX + PLAY showed CLEAR VELOCITY MODS and PLAY again UNDO CLEAR; with the four aftertouch slots in use CHRO + PLAY showed CLEAR AFTERTOUCH MODS, PLAY again UNDO CLEAR, and a new link was then refused again (AFTERTOUCH MODS FULL), so the amounts were back; LFO + PLAY from the SYNTH page showed CLEAR PAGE LFO with the destination's box gone, the page and the stopped sequencer as they were, and LFO + RECORD, PLAY, STOP copied, cleared and pasted the page (the box at +0.12 back); with performances 1 and 2 linked a PERF + knob lock showed with either one unlinked, PERF + PLAY showed CLEAR PERFORMANCES and PLAY again UNDO CLEAR, PERF + YES PERFORMANCES APPLIED and YES again UNDO APPLY; in scene mode with LIVE REC: QUANTIZED, scene 2 then scene 9 engaged, RECORD + YES showed APPLY PERF/SCENE REC and RECORD + NO then NOTHING TO CLEAR; SCENE + knob and SCENE + YES with its undo in the same and a later hold as on 0.6.0.
limitations: Run by the test rig only: the author has not tested 0.7.0 by hand, and nothing was judged by ear.
This package's own image ran in rytm-emu only (the same C source as R707).
Where a quantized scene change lands (the nearest step) was checked in rytm-emu only; on the unit the rig saw the take written, not its steps.
A second LFO + PLAY or STOP cleared or pasted again instead of undoing, on the unit as in rytm-emu.
Paste onto several performances, the full lock table and a lock made by a pad between a clear and its undo were checked in rytm-emu and by code review only.
Duration not recorded.

tests.summary: 0.7.0 in rytm-emu (several links: knob, clear, paste, apply and their undos; FIX, CHRO and LFO + PLAY; a sweep of quantized and unquantized scene changes; 0.6.0's scene checks byte-identical) and 33 rig cases; on the author's unit the rig ran 13 cases on R707. Two independent code reviews before the unit run; see TESTING.md. Earlier versions as recorded there.

media.caption: Improved Modulation
media.alt: FIX plus a knob turn fills the first of four velocity mod slots with +20; SAMPLER plus a knob turn fills the first of four aftertouch slots with +10; LFO plus a knob turn makes SWT the LFO's destination with depth +12. A knob press sets a link to 0, and the links save with the kit.
